canDoYue: 你識講目的地、問大概幾耐，仲識喺街角落車。
canDoEn: Give a destination, ask roughly how long, and ask to stop at a corner.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The taxi is here, and I can give the driver your full address now.
dialogue.glossYue: 的士到咗，我可以而家同司機講你個完整地址。
dialogue.say: The taxi is here, and I can give the driver your full address now.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you take me to the landmark that is opposite the hotel corner?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以載我去酒店街角對面嗰個地標？
dialogue.say: Could you take me to the landmark that is opposite the hotel corner?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The meter is on, and traffic is slow along this street today.
dialogue.glossYue: 咪錶開咗，今日呢條街好塞。
dialogue.say: The meter is on, and traffic is slow along this street today.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How long will this take, roughly, if we go straight and turn left?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果直行再轉左，大概要幾耐？
dialogue.say: How long will this take, roughly, if we go straight and turn left?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: It takes about ten minutes, and I will drop you at that corner.
dialogue.glossYue: 大概十分鐘，我會喺嗰個街角落你。
dialogue.say: It takes about ten minutes, and I will drop you at that corner.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Here is fine, and could I have a receipt before I leave the taxi?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢度得喇，落車之前可唔可以畀張收據？
dialogue.say: Here is fine, and could I have a receipt before I leave the taxi?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Here is your receipt, and you can see the landmark on your right.
dialogue.glossYue: 收據喺度，你可以睇到地標喺你右手邊。
dialogue.say: Here is your receipt, and you can see the landmark on your right.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thank you, and I will walk straight from this corner to the door.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝，我會由呢個街角直行去門口。
dialogue.say: Thank you, and I will walk straight from this corner to the door.

sound.title: 地標開頭嗰個音
sound.note: landmark 開頭係 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面，氣由兩邊出。meter 第二音係輕 /ɚ/。traffic 重音喺第一節。
